title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobDescription:
Location: Hyderabad, India Experience: 5+ Years Employment Type: Full-time

ROLE:
We are looking for an experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong expertise in Computer Vision, Deep Learning, and Model Optimization to build and deploy production-ready AI solutions.The role involves developing end-to-end ML pipelines, improving model performance, and solving real-world visual intelligence problems. Key Responsibilities Build and deploy AI/ML pipelines from data preprocessing to production inference. Develop computer vision solutions for object detection, image processing, and visual data extraction. Train, fine-tune, and optimize deep learning models for accuracy and performance. Analyze model results, troubleshoot failures, and improve system reliability. Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate ML models into scalable applications. Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS). Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and ML deployment workflows Exposure to OCR, Document AI, or multimodal AI systems is a plus. Key

Strong consultative selling, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills. Ability to engage with senior business and technology stakeholders. Excellent account management, business development, and relationship-building capabilities.

QUALIFICATIONS:
MBA in Marketing, Business Administration, or a Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or Technology. Experience working with global clients across North America, EMEA, or APAC is preferred. Apply Online or Mail your CVs to [email protected]
